item.title: Feb. 5, 2026: Around the Region
item.description: FRIEDENSBURG A tree identification walk called “This BUD is for YOU!” is set for 10 to 11 a.m. Feb. 7 at the Frog Hollow Nature Center. Participants will meet at the parking area off Stone Mountain Road outside Friedensburg. Will Thomas, a service forester with the Pennsylvania Bureau of Forestry and an expert dendrologist, will guide a winter walk focused on tree identification. Participants will discover how to recognize native trees and shrubs in their winter forms via unique characteristics.
